prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background for an original browser pixel RPG title, 16:9 landscape. Image 1 is the approved composition reference, NOT a screenshot to reproduce. Create the same rich 16-bit GBA-inspired sunlit adventure mood: a jade river valley with terracotta-roofed village on the left middle distance, a stone bridge, green mountains, distant brass observatory on the right hill, leafy tree framing upper-left, flowers and stone path in foreground. On the RIGHT foreground keep a small human trainer from behind (red cap, short coral travel jacket, tan backpack), jade fox with cream face and gold folded tail fan, coral scholar owl, two-headed cobalt salamander. Use clean deliberate square pixel clusters, plum outlines, restrained dithering, crisp palette, no soft gradients. IMPORTANT: remove ALL text, ALL logo, ALL menu frames and ALL interface from the reference. The lower-left foreground is a quieter patch of shaded grass and path reserved for separately rendered HTML game menu. Upper center is open blue sky reserved for separate live logo. Draw a complete scenic world asset; no UI baked into image, no text, no watermarks, no company/game logos.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production battle sprite atlas for an original 16-bit handheld browser RPG. Images 1, 2 and 3 are character identity references only. Make ONE exact regular 3-column by 2-row atlas on a transparent canvas. Six separate sprites, no text, labels, frames, grid lines or floor shadows. Column 1 Emberquill the coral scholar owl with cream face and quill brow; column 2 Kitewhisk the jade fox with cream face, clay scarf and ONE gold folded-paper tail fan; column 3 Duplet the cobalt two-headed salamander with cyan fins and gold stars. TOP ROW: full-body front three-quarter battle pose, facing toward lower left, friendly determined expression, completely within its own equal cell. BOTTOM ROW: corresponding full-body BACK three-quarter view facing upper right, same character scale and proportions, show the back of its head and anatomy, NOT a mirrored front. All sprites share the same foot baseline in each row and comfortable transparent padding; center each in its cell. Crisp true GBA-style pixel clusters designed at about 96x96 logical pixels per sprite, dark plum 1-pixel outlines, 4-tone palette per material, no soft painted edges, no blur, no antialias, no gradient glow. Preserve distinct silhouettes and make the back poses unmistakable. Transparent background with real alpha, no white rectangle, no checker pattern.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art OVERWORLD CHARACTER SPRITE ATLAS for an original GBA-inspired RPG. Image 1 trainer identity reference; images 2,3,4 companion identity references. ONE EXACT uniform grid of 4 COLUMNS and 4 ROWS = 16 sprites. Each equal cell contains one centered tiny sprite with transparent padding, feet baseline at 88% of cell height. Columns from left to right: human trainer (red cap, coral jacket, tan backpack, dark shorts, boots); coral scholar owl Emberquill; jade fox Kitewhisk with short clay scarf and gold folded tail fan; TWO-HEADED cobalt salamander Duplet with cyan fins. Rows top to bottom: facing SOUTH toward viewer; facing WEST left side; facing EAST right side; facing NORTH away showing backs. Strict top-down three-quarter handheld RPG overworld perspective. All 16 sprites small and readable, characters designed on approximately 24x32 logical pixel grid, deliberate blocky square pixel clusters, 1px plum outline, no painted detail. The trainer and companions all similar small footprint, complete bodies within their own cell. No labels, no text, no UI, no grid lines, no logos, no floor/background/drop shadows. Real transparent alpha background. Preserve original character silhouettes; do not introduce Pokemon characters or symbols.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent ENVIRONMENT OBJECT ATLAS for an original GBA-style top-down pixel RPG, one uniform grid with THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, six objects centered fully inside their own equal-size cell with wide transparent padding. Top row left: a welcoming small cream-stone cottage with terracotta roof, teal door, flower boxes; top middle: companion guild building with larger terracotta gable roof, brass diamond sign, blue door, no writing; top right: old Archive library with plum-gray stone, slate roof, brass arched doorway and teal crystal. Bottom row left: one lush rounded jade deciduous tree with visible trunk; bottom middle: tall elegant brass relay lantern on small stone base, warm gold glass and leafy wreath; bottom right: forest stone arch with moss, small lilac crystals and open walk-through gap. Cohesive top-down three-quarter 16-bit handheld world perspective, crisp true pixel art at approximately 80x80 logical pixels per cell, deliberate square pixel clusters, plum outlines, warm highlights, controlled 4-shade material ramps, charming finely crafted architectural details. Transparent actual alpha background; no ground plane, no shadows outside object, no text, no lettering, no interface, no labels, no grid/borders, no logos. Do not merge objects or let any object cross into another cell. World assets, NOT a screenshot.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent battle-enemy sprite atlas for original GBA-style RPG. ONE exact 2-column by 1-row regular atlas, two original enemy sprites centered within equal cells with transparent padding, same foot baseline. LEFT: Static Wisp, a small floating lilac/pink signal creature with a tapering three-tail lower body, two expressive cream eyes, charcoal-plum outline, little angular static tufts, playful mischievous not scary. RIGHT: Archive Warden, a larger ancient stone-and-brass book guardian, sturdy quadruped-like mechanical body, open-book shoulder plates, dark plum stone, teal core, brass lantern eyes and small horns like bookmark tabs. Both full-body front three-quarter battle view facing lower-left, deliberate crisp square pixel clusters on approximately 96x96 logical grid, limited GBA 16-bit palette and 1px outline, no smooth airbrush. Atlas background genuinely transparent alpha. NO company mascots, existing videogame characters, text, labels, frames, grid lines, landscape, floor, shadows outside sprites, logos or watermark. Make these distinct from the player's friendly companions.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent NPC overworld sprite atlas for an original GBA-like RPG, ONE equal 3-column by 1-row grid. Three distinct human villagers, full bodies, standing facing south toward viewer, top-down three-quarter game perspective, approximately 24x32 logical pixel sprites, centered in each cell with identical foot baseline and transparent padding. Left Mara the Keeper: warm middle-aged woman, chestnut bun, ochre apron over coral blouse, small brass lantern in one hand, kind expression. Middle Ivo the Scout: young adult man with tan skin, forest-green cap, green ranger tunic, short boots and satchel, no red cap. Right Neri the Scholar: older woman with silver bob, round glasses, plum robe and blue book, no cap. Crisp deliberate 16-bit pixel clusters, 1px plum outline, controlled sunlit palette, readable small silhouettes. No player trainer, no companions, no company marks, no text, labels, grid lines, UI, floor, ground shadows, scenery or watermark. True transparent alpha background. All three separate sprites completely contained in their cells.
